description: This file defines a BusyTimesService class responsible for calculating busy time slots based on bookings and calendar data, including methods for fetching and processing booking and calendar busy times, with batching and performance optimizations.

classes.name: BusyTimesService
classes.description: Service class for calculating busy times based on bookings and calendar data, with methods for fetching, processing, and batching booking data.

methods.name: _getBusyTimes
methods.description: Main method to compute busy times considering bookings and calendar busy times, with support for buffers, rescheduling, and batching.

methods.name: getBusyTimes
methods.description: Wrapped version of _getBusyTimes with reporting, exposed publicly.

methods.name: getStartEndDateforLimitCheck
methods.description: Calculates expanded date range for limit checks based on provided limits.

methods.name: getBusyTimesForLimitChecks
methods.description: Fetches busy times for multiple users within a date range, considering booking and duration limits.

methods.name: fetchBookingsForLimitChecksBatched
methods.description: Performs batched parallel queries to fetch bookings for multiple users efficiently.

methods.name: fetchBookingsForLimitChecksBatch
methods.description: Fetches bookings for a single batch of user IDs using Prisma, optimized for large datasets.
